g.text: Published Biological Effect vs TFM Prediction Skill

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #666666

g.text: Shows: published group-level effect (left bar, control-arm mean change) and TFM prediction skill (right bar, Spearman ρ) for three targets.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #666666

g.text: Does NOT show: individual-level variation, calibration, or what drives the BMD signal.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #666666

g.text: Sources: Ploutz-Snyder 2018 (BMD, fat); Miller 2018 (tandem); Biomni A10G null test (BMD); Colab T4 summaries (fat, tandem)
